title: Competing CTAs dilute primary action
summary: The homepage presents four competing CTAs, diluting the primary signup action and creating ambiguity in the first step of the funnel.
problem: Multiple competing CTAs on the homepage dilute the primary signup action, creating ambiguity in the first step of the funnel.
recommended_change: h1: AI notetaker that automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings; cta: Start for free (primary), secondary links in nav/footer; notes: Single dominant CTA; move demo, app, support to nav/footer; add Pricing link.
evidence: ctas: Book a demo | Start for free | Get the desktop app | Contact support | h1: AI notetaker that works (magic) in the background
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift
